text:
The Panthers have been the Tkachuk show. Matthew and Brady on the same line with Sam Bennett, the brothers back in St. Louis for the night the Blues honored their father Keith, and plenty of criticism around the league for how they play. That line has taken 57% of the expected goals (the quality of chances), which is the part that matters.

Florida is 12-7-2 with 26 points, winners of three straight with 53% of the chances in those games. The underlying season looks like a contender: 53% of the five-on-five expected goals and a power play producing 1.11 expected goals a game. Results and process roughly agree here, and our playoff odds sit at 68%.

Then there is who isn't back yet. Reports have Aleksander Barkov and Brad Marchand near returns, and adding a captain who is one of the league's best two-way centers to this lineup would change the math. Sandis Vilmanis has been in and out after the Tom Wilson hit that drew no suspension. The Lars Eller, Carter Verhaeghe and Sam Reinhart line has outscored teams 7-1.

The worry is discipline: 5.43 penalties taken a game, which is a lot of time killing penalties even for a team that draws as many as it takes. What we'd watch: the first week with Barkov and Marchand back, whenever it comes.
